name: Graph-color C1 matched-budget targeting independence
purpose: Complete Part A's second graph_color targeting variant: run graph_color matched-budget A_cache vs C_incontext under the same C1 zero-shot conflict-analysis targeting policy, n=64, v16_p04/R16. This tests whether the cache-truncation solve@budget advantage holds with reasoned targeting, not only symbolic/oracle-search targeting.

headline.single_next_move: Proceed to HB-2 no-train external baselines through BudgetRunner; do not fabricate Beyond-the-Frontier without an official repo.

honesty.method_note: The C1 policy trace is generated once per instance and billed as both A_cache and C_incontext to isolate reversal mechanism from targeting decisions.
honesty.billing_note: C_incontext billing includes the growing transcript plus C1 prompt/output tokens; A_cache billing uses retained-prefix/cache-step token accounting. Both arms share the same decisions and official scoring.
honesty.external_limit: No external BudgetRunner baselines are evaluated here.
